# storage medium

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:storageMedium`](gmeow-storageMedium.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/storageMedium>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The medium of a storage location (a [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](../classes/gmeow-StorageMedium.md) individual). Functional: the medium is constitutive of the storage location (a different medium is a different store) — unlike the descriptive, multi-source [`gmeow:placeType`](gmeow-placeType.md).
